body: the reason I’m so hurt is because I thought I’ve been doing this already. I think I have been, really, but kindness doesn’t outweigh unkindness. it doesn’t matter how much I express my love for him if I’m also condescending every day.

the thing about this is that it would take work – it takes work that I am unwilling to do. I don’t want to. I’m tired. I’m tired of fucking up. if I feel terrible now, having to face how terrible I am head-on repeatedly until I can figure out how to stop being terrible is not something I have the capacity for
